text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco calls for support of development programmes in association with private sector, at meeting of IMF and World Bank development committee.

- Moroccan navy inspects German yacht in Mediterranean, finds 14 packets of cannabis with total weight of about 200 kg (440 pounds). Yacht and three German nationals handed over to customs authorities.
- Morocco seriously considering closing secretariat which ovesees Middle East and North Africa summits because of lack of progress in economic process launched in Casablanca in 1994.
- Morocco and Benin plan to set up real partnership between private sectors to promote development.
- Deforestation in Morocco reaching alarming proportions.
